name: full_input_cross_refit_v1
protocol: Full-data refit of the promoted cross-attention fusion. Epochs match the mean optimizer-update count selected independently on the two full training folds; schedule and warmup are scaled the same way as the existing self-attention refits.

ensemble.selection_source: Fold-local grouped-inner study selected 0.75 self-attention and 0.25 cross-attention before the full-fold cross results were read. Seeds are averaged within each architecture.
